disclaimer: Reminder reference only — NOT legal authority. Season dates, zones, and limits are set annually and can change. Always verify current regulations with the Ohio Division of Wildlife before hunting or trapping.

license_summary.general: A valid Ohio hunting license is required to hunt furbearers; a fur taker permit is required to trap furbearing animals (residents and nonresidents). River otters are a CITES Appendix II species — Ohio requires mandatory tagging/registration of harvested otters (verify current tagging/check procedures with the Division of Wildlife; a proposed 2026 change to online otter check-in could not be confirmed as of 2026-09-18).

sources.notes: Rule 1501:31-15-17(B) (via Register of Ohio filings): 'It shall be unlawful for any person to hunt or take a bobcat, bear, badger, fisher, porcupine or a snowshoe hare at any time.' Also Rule 1501:31-15-17(A): no open hunting season on wild animals unless expressly set forth. Ohio Bobcat Management Plan (ODNR): bobcat harvest is not currently permitted.

A 2026 proposed rule change regarding online otter check-in/CITES procedures could not be confirmed — the ODNR proposed-rules page failed to load on 2026-09-18. Verify current otter registration/check requirements with the Division of Wildlife before the Dec 26 season.
'Fox' in the rule covers red and gray fox (modeled as separate species records sharing the same season); 'skunk' modeled as striped skunk; 'weasel' is unspecified in the rule.
Woodchuck continuous season comes from the 2026-27 season sheet only; woodchuck is not in Rule 1501:31-15-18's furbearer list.
No daily bag or possession limits apply to any Ohio furbearer (sheet limit column: 'None').
